capabilities: add YouTube channels by URL or handle
show the latest eligible video per channel in a dashboard
cache video details in plugin data
extras: No YouTube account, API key, or backend needed; Shorts detection is best-effort and may break if YouTube changes its pages or feeds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow YouTube channel uploads, and Shorts clutter the feed data.
summary: Dashboard plugin that manually tracks recent uploads from chosen YouTube channels, with Shorts filtered from the feed.
